title: test(app-shell): inherit the real @object-ui/collaboration surface in 33 vi.mock factories
body:
Part of #6892 — slice 4 of the per-specifier `vi.mock` sweep worklist: `@object-ui/collaboration`, the largest row left on it after slice 3.

All 33 frozen `@object-ui/collaboration` factories now obtain the real module and spread it before their overrides, and the specifier joins `COVERED_SPECIFIERS` in `scripts/check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs` in the same PR — the gate's documented widening precondition.

> Generic type arguments below are spelled as CAPITALISED WORDS rather than in angle brackets, because GitHub's body sanitizer silently deletes tag-shaped fragments — including inside backticks and fenced blocks (AGENTS.md, "GitHub 会改写你写进 issue/PR 正文的字节"). The code itself uses the real syntax.

## STEP 0 — what does inheriting actually RUN?

Converting a freeze to inheritance loads the real barrel in every converted file, so a barrel with module-scope side effects has those effects restored in 33 files at once. Slice 3 made this a standing step rather than an auth special case, and a collaboration package is a priori the most likely one yet to fail it: presence, realtime subscriptions, sockets.

The whole static import graph was walked from `packages/collaboration/src/index.ts` (98 lines) and every top-level statement of every reached module classified with the TypeScript parser. **11 modules**, and exactly **11 module-scope initialisers**, every one of them pure in-memory allocation:

| file:line | what runs at import |
| --- | --- |
| `useConflictResolution.ts:58` | `conflictCounter` — a `let` at `0` |
| `useConflictResolution.ts:65` | `versionIdCounter` — a `let` at `0` |
| `CommentThread.tsx:152` | `styles` — an object literal of class strings |
| `useCollaborationTranslation.ts:46` | `COLLAB_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` — the English defaults map |
| `useCollaborationTranslation.ts:121` | `useCollaborationTranslation` — one `createSafeTranslation(...)` call |
| `LiveCursors.tsx:29` | `cursorStyles` — an object literal |
| `PresenceAvatars.tsx:29` | `sizeMap` — an object literal |
| `PresenceAvatars.tsx:35` | `statusColors` — an object literal |
| `PresenceAvatars.tsx:58` | `statusLabelKeys` — an object literal |
| `PresenceProvider.tsx:44` | `NOOP_SOURCE` — an empty object literal |
| `PresenceProvider.tsx:46` | `PresenceContext` — `React.createContext(NOOP_SOURCE)` |

The one module-scope **call** was read rather than assumed: `createSafeTranslation` (`packages/i18n/src/useSafeTranslation.ts:19`) allocates a `fallbackT` closure and returns a hook. It registers nothing, touches no global, and starts nothing.

And **zero** of the things that would have stopped this slice: no registrations, no timers, no globals, no `fetch`, no storage access, no `WebSocket` construction at module scope, and no side-effect-only imports. Two column-anchored greps back the AST walk, both returning no match (`grep` exit 1): module-scope `window` / `document` / `globalThis` / `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` / `setTimeout` / `setInterval` / `fetch` / `navigator` / `WebSocket` / `EventSource`, and module-scope `IDENT.register(` / `.init(` / `.configure(` / `.addEventListener(`. Every `new WebSocket(...)`, `setTimeout(...)` and `window.addEventListener(...)` in the package is indented inside a hook body — 19 such lines in `useRealtimeSubscription.ts`, 7 in `usePresence.ts`, and the walk attributes **none** of them to module scope.

Transitively the barrel's only RUNTIME workspace import is `@object-ui/i18n` (`@object-ui/types` is imported type-only everywhere, including the barrel's own re-export block). `@object-ui/i18n` is already covered by this gate at 92 judged / 92 inheriting, so its real barrel is already loaded in these tests.

⇒ **Inert. Proceeding.**

### ⚠️ One way this slice is WEAKER than slice 3, stated rather than glossed

`@object-ui/auth` came with a free independent confirmation: 33 of its 135 sites already inherited the real barrel on `main`, so the barrel demonstrably loaded in that test environment before anything was converted. `@object-ui/collaboration` had **ZERO** inheriting sites, and a sweep of the whole tree finds **no test that loads the real barrel at runtime** (its package's own four component tests import relative paths; the fifth is a type-only spec-symbol pin). So there was no pre-existing green site to lean on, and the confirmation here is the suite run itself — weaker evidence, and recorded as such in the gate header so the next slice on a zero-inheriting specifier budgets for it.

## STEP 1 — the derived table

Re-derived on the merge base `0caacca37` with the FIXED classifier, through the guard's exported `scan()` with `covered` set to all 22 workspace specifiers the tree names. ⛔ The constant in the tree was never widened-and-reverted, so there was no window in which a mutated constant could have been committed. Nothing was inherited from the card's table or from the dispatch.

| | judged | inheriting before | frozen before | frozen after |
| --- | --: | --: | --: | --: |
| `@object-ui/collaboration` | 33 | **0** | **33** | **0** |

All-specifier population on this PR's own base: **211 → 178 frozen**, judged unchanged at 643, 0 unreadable, and **every other one of the 21 rows byte-identical between the two runs** — zero sites moving the other way.

The dispatch's grep upper bound (33 files, all `packages/app-shell`) turned out to be **exact** this time, distribution included: 33 of 33 under `packages/app-shell/src`, none in `apps/console`.

## STEP 2 — the conversion

**One shape, not three.** Unlike `@object-ui/auth`, all 33 sites are the multi-line object-literal arrow, so the conversion is uniform: `() =` plus arrow becomes `async (importOriginal) =` plus arrow, and a spread of `await importOriginal()` (generic argument RECORD-OF-STRING-TO-UNKNOWN) becomes the **first** property of the returned object. Seven distinct override sets across the 33 files, all presence/realtime stand-ins.

The span of every factory was delimited with the **gate's own** masking helpers (`deJsxClosingTags` plus `js-comment-mask`), never with a naive regex over raw source, so a `vi.mock` inside a comment or a string could not have been rewritten.

**No site was a deliberate freeze.** Nothing in the 33 was written to prove a module is *not* loaded, so nothing was converted blindly or reported as an exception. ⛔ No exemption table, ⛔ no per-site opt-out.

**No file died during collection.** The 33 files report **33 passed / 280 tests** both before and after the conversion — the same numbers, measured by restoring the base blobs of exactly those 33 paths under a restore trap and re-running. The failure class this worklist exists for did not fire once.

## The pin test had to move, and why raising the number was the wrong repair

`scripts/__tests__/check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts` read the gate's header as `.slice(0, 12000)` and asserted two phrases in it. This slice's header record pushed `precondition for widening is a sweep` from byte 12512 past that window, reddening the pin **without touching a word either assertion reads**.

Re-raising the constant would only defer the identical failure to slice 5. The window now IS the leading docblock — located by its own delimiters — plus an assertion that the window is still shorter than the whole file, so the two phrase checks cannot silently degrade into "matches anywhere in the source". 69 of 69 cases pass, unchanged in count.

## Residuals — none

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowNodeInspector.specKeys.test.tsx` (held for #7307 batch 6 behind draft PR #7685) **is not a site** — it carries no `@object-ui/collaboration` reference at all, so the named exclusion cost nothing.
- Draft PR #7685's 67 files (REST, paged to exhaustion) intersect this PR's 33 sites in **zero** paths.

⇒ collaboration reads **0 frozen** on this tree with nothing held back, so the `COVERED_SPECIFIERS` line ships in full.

## Ablation — three legs, from the committed tree

Each leg mutates, proves the mutation reached the disk by counting the anchored text, reads the result, then restores with `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH` under a `trap` on EXIT INT TERM — restore proven by `git hash-object` equalling the HEAD blob **and** an empty `git diff HEAD`, never by a `git checkout` exit code.

| leg | mutation | on-disk proof | result | restore |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AppHeader.singleMembershipOrg.test.tsx` | reverse the conversion on its one collaboration factory | spread marker 4 → 3, frozen head form 0 → 1 | gate **exit 1**, names exactly this file, 1 site line | blob `ffae1956b`, `git diff HEAD` empty, gate exit 0 |
| `RecordDetailView.feedLoading.test.tsx` | same | spread marker 2 → 1, frozen head form 0 → 1 | gate **exit 1**, names exactly this file, 1 site line | blob `d4ed32a0b`, `git diff HEAD` empty, gate exit 0 |
| `check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs` (the repaired pin) | delete the asserted header phrase | phrase count 1 → 0 | pin **exit 1** on that case, and the failure message shows the received value starting at the docblock, proving the new window is the docblock | blob `857bd0365`, `git diff HEAD` empty |

The first leg is the load-bearing one: that file holds **four** inheriting factories on different specifiers and the mutation removed exactly one, so the reversal is proven surgical rather than a broad delete. No dist preflight is needed — the root `vitest.config.mts` aliases `@object-ui/collaboration` to `packages/collaboration/src`, and the gate is a source-text scanner.

`origin/main` moved 4 commits during verification and was **merged** (never rebased). It touched **zero** files under `packages/app-shell/`, proven by `git diff` over the whole package path returning empty between the sweep commit and the final head — so the four-shard suite reading transfers exactly. Every other gate above was re-run at `400db5cfc`, on a dependency closure rebuilt with real per-package `tsc` runs rather than a turbo replay.

⚠️ One reading deliberately NOT claimed: `pnpm check:node-esm-load` exits 1 here, and it is **not this PR's gate** — its workflow is nightly plus a path filter on `scripts/check-node-esm-load.mjs`, which this diff does not touch. Its failure is its own documented shared-turbo-cache refusal (22 of 37 entries were replayed into this worktree from sibling worktrees `objectui-issue-5174-b23` and `objectui-issue-7811`, and the gate declines to grade artifacts this tree did not produce — objectui#7276, remedy `--force-build`). It names **zero** of this PR's 36 paths. The dependency closure was rebuilt afterwards so no type-check reading above sits on those foreign artifacts.

`Live E2E (informational)` is red on every branch today for an upstream reason (#7990 / objectstack#16186) — not this change.

## One finding carried out of scope, filed separately

Now that the 33 factories inherit, the overrides that remain are visible as a set — and 13 of them stub `useRecordPresence` as an object while the real hook returns an array. Filed as a `finding`, ⛔ not fixed here (changing a stub's value shape is a behaviour change this slice was not dispatched to make).

`@object-ui/plugin-form` (32 judged / 31 frozen), then `@object-ui/components` (47 / 27), `@object-ui/plugin-grid` (24 / 24) and `@object-ui/app-shell` (23 / 23 — still reads #6580 first, which is CLOSED, so that is now a git-history read). STEP 0 stays standing, and the census stays re-derived on the merge base at conversion time: the population moved under slice 3 twice, and `main` moved 4 commits under this one.
